claims.claim_text: AVAV's Switchblade family (Switchblade 300 and Switchblade 600 loitering munitions) is a named precision-strike product line presented as a core forward growth pillar of the Autonomous Systems segment.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.source_quote: Our Switchblade family includes the Switchblade 300 and Switchblade 600, which are loitering munitions solutions and provide portable, low-signature, precision strike capabilities against static or mobile targets.

claims.claim_text: AVAV's Small UAS portfolio includes Puma LE, Puma 3 AE, Puma VTOL, P550, Raven B and VAPOR 55 MX, positioned as Group 1-2 systems sold to U.S. Army/SOCOM/allied governments.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.source_quote: Products include Puma LE, Puma 3 AE, Puma VTOL, P550, Raven B, and VAPOR 55 MX. Systems within the SUAS portfolio utilize our common and interoperable handheld ground control systems.

claims.claim_text: AVAV's Medium UAS (Group 3) portfolio is anchored by JUMP 20, JUMP 20-X and T-20 (legacy Arcturus airframes) positioned for the Army FTUAS Program of Record.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.source_quote: Our Group 3 solutions include the JUMP 20, JUMP 20-X, and T-20. All are field-deployable and deliver extended endurance and increased payload capacity to unlock a broader set of uncrewed missions.

claims.claim_text: AVAV (post-BlueHalo) operates a Directed Energy product line including the Locust Laser Weapon System (LWS) and Locust TATS, positioned for forward DoD directed-energy demand within the Space, Cyber and Directed Energy segment.
claims.subject: AeroVironment / BlueHalo
claims.source_quote: Directed Energy: The Locust Laser Weapon System ( LWS ) and Locust TATS uses advanced AI and engineering for an effective directed energy kill chain, tracking, identifying, and defeating targets with a high energy laser system.

claims.claim_text: AVAV (post-BlueHalo) markets a PANTHER family of phased-array antenna systems supporting hypersonic telemetry and tracking, positioned as forward exposure to Pentagon hypersonics work.
claims.subject: AeroVironment / BlueHalo
claims.source_quote: Our PANTHER family of systems supports hypersonic telemetry and tracking and other missile testing.

claims.claim_text: AVAV (post-BlueHalo) provides space platform subsystems (steering mirrors, power system controllers, command/data handling, spacecraft attitude determination and control units) positioned for SDA Transport Layer / Tranche 3 satellite buses.
claims.subject: AeroVironment / BlueHalo
claims.object_value: Space subsystems / SDA Transport Layer Tranche 3
claims.source_quote: steering mirrors, power system controllers, command and data handling, and spacecraft attitude determination and control units.

claims.claim_text: AVAV reported total backlog of $726.6M as of April 30, 2025 (vs $400.2M prior year) and expects ~90% to convert to FY2026 revenue; unfunded backlog grew to $774.6M (from $135.4M).
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: $726.6M funded backlog, ~90% recognized in FY2026; $774.6M unfunded backlog
claims.source_quote: As of April 30, 2025 and 2024, our backlog was approximately $726.6 million and $400.2 million, respectively. We expect that approximately 90% of our backlog will be recognized as revenue during our fiscal year ending April 30, 2026. In addition to funded backlog, we also had unfunded backlog of $774.6 million and $135.4 million.

claims.claim_text: AVAV reports FY2025 (pre-BlueHalo) customer concentration: ~20% of revenue from U.S. Army, 27% from other U.S. government / subcontractors, 53% foreign (of which Ukraine = 18% of total revenue); expects DoD share to increase in FY2026 with BlueHalo.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.source_quote: During our fiscal year ended April 30, 2025, prior to the acquisition of BlueHalo, we generated approximately 20% of our revenue from the U.S. Army... other U.S. government agencies and government subcontractors accounted for 27% of our sales revenue... foreign customers... 53% of sales revenue... of which Ukraine accounted for 18% of our total sales revenue.

claims.claim_text: AVAV holds a portfolio of U.S. registered trademarks (AeroVironment, AV, Switchblade, Raven, VAPOR, Arcturus UAV, JUMP, Tomahawk Robotics, Kinesis) and obtained an additional 150 issued U.S. patents via the BlueHalo acquisition.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.source_quote: we have many U.S. registered trademarks including those for AeroVironment, AV, Switchblade, Raven, VAPOR, Arcturus UAV, JUMP, Tomahawk Robotics, and Kinesis... Upon the closing of the BlueHalo acquisition on May 1, 2025, we obtained an additional 150 issued U.S. patents.

claims.claim_text: AVAV previously disclosed a non-cash MUAS goodwill impairment after not being down-selected on a U.S. DoD program of record (legacy Arcturus FTUAS competition), demonstrating program-loss materiality.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: MUAS goodwill impairment from missed PoR down-select
